generate_enum_bindings: generate Embind bindings for MuJoCo enums from a list of EnumDecl objects
build_enum_code: build Embind enum binding code for sorted non-empty MuJoCo enum declarations
test_generate_function: test the generate function with sample EnumDecl objects and verify output format
refactor_generate: refactor the generate function to support custom enum name mappings
summarize_generate: summarize the generate function that produces Embind code from enum declarations
